text:
maria: Heads-up — customer reported being billed twice after a truncated stream + reconnect + toolcall replay. looks like provisional credits at handoff aren't deduped on resume.
kevin: doh. any repro traces?
maria: yes, router logs show handoff to region-b then reconnect to region-c and both provisional entries get confirmed later. log snippet: 
```
2026-03-18T16:12:01Z router-1 HANDOFF session=svc-7Yk last_ack=125 provisional_id=pv-9a
2026-03-18T16:12:02Z downstream-b ACCEPT session=svc-7Yk start_offset=126 toolcall=calc-42
2026-03-18T16:12:10Z client reconnect session=svc-7Yk new_route=region-c resume_from=125
2026-03-18T16:12:11Z router-2 PROVISIONAL_CREATE session=svc-7Yk provisional_id=pv-9b
2026-03-18T16:12:18Z downstream-c ACCEPT session=svc-7Yk confirmed_ids=[pv-9a,pv-9b]
```
kevin: confirmed both pv-9a & pv-9b — double charge. We don't seem to carry the original toolcall nonce across routes.
sara: does router include the original downstream_req id or trace? without that we can't dedupe across region handoffs.
maria: router currently sets a handoff_id but provisional ledger entries only include session+offset+provisional_id — no handoff id.
alex: short-term fix: embed handoff_id + downstream_req_id into provisional metadata and use them in reconciliation to dedupe before confirming. downside: metadata size increase and migration pain.
sara: long-term proposal: 1) add session_origin_id (handoff id) to provisional entries; 2) reconciler groups by session_origin_id and offsets when confirming; 3) console shows provisional vs confirmed separately and doesn't surface provisional as bill until confirmed. ops UX: provisional row with tooltip "may reconcile on confirm".
kevin: agree. Also need telemetry: provisional_credits_created{region,deploy,route} + resume_count tag so SRE can alert on spikes.
maria: found another edge: truncation + toolcall TTL -> provisional created but downstream never accepted before reconnect => orphaned provisional. need GC/tombstone.
alex: quick router patch: when seeing a resume with resume_from <= last_ack and existing provisional for same session+offset, mark new provisional as deduped and skip ledger write. cheap and reduces noise.
sara: console changes: - Route -> Requests pane: show provisional credits - toggle to include provisional in cost estimate - chart provisional vs confirmed over time + alert when provisional/confirmed ratio spikes
kevin: who owns reconciler change? @maria?
maria: I'll own reconciliation grouping and adding handoff_id to provisional entries. drafting RFC and will attach traces.
kevin: I'll do the short-term router dedupe patch and post a PR after standup.
sara: I'll mock console UX and build dashboards + alerts.
alex: I'll review storage schema for adding handoff_id and estimate migration cost.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: feature/provisional-dedupe -> staging at 2026-03-19T02:00Z :rocket:
maria: thanks, will link the customer repro & traces in the RFC. :thumbsup:
